Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review_Title: A true partner for the road and track
Review: This car gave me 185,228 miles of devoted service before passing into the automotive afterworld.  Every mile was a pure pleasure, whether on the road or on the track.  Great for long trips, aggressive driving, racing, and the daily commute.  I could not ask for anything more of a car. Access is great, even if the rear is a little tight.  My 90+ year old grandma always commented how easy the car was to enter/exit.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: I bought this 1998 SVT Contuor in 2003 after always wanting one. This car does not dissapoint. It is certainly a drivers car. Not the fastest at drags, but it will outdo most anything when it comes to finesse and balance. I am impressed there are no rattles or shakes at 60K miles. Surprisingly solid. I would recommend buying one used over many of the new sports sedans of today.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: This car is awesome, i have been that person who has been bad talking ford for over five years now.  But once i saw this car i fell in love. For the price one can't go wrong.  The interior has every creature comfort. Everything feels solid, and the performance is out of this world, very un FORD like.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review_Title: this car sucks all the way around
Review: I purchased this car from car max.  It shuts itself off when I am driving it.  Ford won't fix it or even admit that it has a problem.  I even wrote to Ford twice and they blew me off.  The check engine light comes on all the time for no reason.  I just ignore it, now.  It does NOT come on when the car shuts itself off.  The Ford dealer implied that since I am female, I don't know how to drive standard shift cars.  I have been driving standard shift for 30 years.  I can't think of one good thing to say about this car.  I'm going back to Honda

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: I bought this car new in 1998 and still can't find anything new I like better.  It is the best shifting car I've ever driven.  The engine and exhaust make noises under throttle that have you smiling ear to ear.I will mention the car's one flaw, the differential is not strong enough to take the horsepower and torque.  I had to replace mine and I went with an aftermarket torsion type differential and the car is even more fun to drive. I recommend this as a fun and practical everyday car.  There is nothing like just taking it for a good drive on a twisty road.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: I had owned my SVT Contour (1998 coreador red) for nearly 4 years, having bought it used in 1999.  Sadly, the car went up in flames about a week ago.  In a fire possibly related to leaking power steering fluid, this thing lit up like a roman candle; fortunately no one was hurt.  Anyway, with the exception of the above noted issue, these cars are fairly reliable, and of course are blessed with amazing handling.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review_Title: Better than really good, but not perfect
Review: Title says it all

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: In reading other reviews of the Contour, it becomes evident that the owners of higher level Contours (SVT and SE/SE sport) are far more pleased with their cars. For me, the SVT was an obvious choice due to its ground effects with wire mesh, standard leather seats, strictly 5-speed transmission, and last but definitely not least, the amazing sound that this car lets out. Sometimes I find myself turning the radio off to listen to my exhaust. Once the car hits 3500 RPM's, you can hear and feel the power that the Duratec 2.5 High Output produces.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: Forget what you think you know about the Ford Contour.  The Contour SVT rivals BMW 3 Series in handling, and I personally have blown a few away through the twisty curves.  An understated outward appearance makes it even more fun!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: I owned my SVT contour for a little over 5 months before a hideous accident took her away from me.  I rear ended a stalled car at about 60 mph.  Ouch...  However I can not say enough about the engineers over at Ford's SVT dept.  The performance and handling was perfectly matched to the safty features.  I totaled mine but crave another.  As a living testament to the safty and outstanding ride, I would suggest my 98 SVT over most German made sedans today.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: I have owed my SVT for 4+ years.  Despite (stupidly) overpaying for the car (sleazy, high-pressure dealer) I have thouroughly enjoyed it.  It has enough power to press and still looks good enough to turn heads 5 years later.  Handeling is superb. There have been a few minor problems with the moonroof and driver seat, but other than that the car has been trouble free.  Snow tires are necessary in the winter.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: Overall one of the most underated cars out there speed, handling, comfort, its got it all... With the efficiency of four doors and the speed of a sport coupe it's great. Definatly better looking than all the sport hatches. Only real problem is the annoying radio and cup holders, makes one wonder what kind of cups Ford uses to test them. Back seat is a little small for road-trips with 4 passengers.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: This has to be one of the best cars I have ever had.  This vehilce is comfortable and always reliable.  I have had it for alittle over a year and I don;t want to get rid of it.  I have been searching for more to locate, but i cannot find any.  This car is unique and it is nice to have a car that is fast, reliable, comfortable, and everyone doesn't have around town.  Thank you ford!!

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: The engine loves to be revved and sounds wonderful while doing it.  The shifter action and handling are the best from any fwd American car yet.  Sure, its low 15 second 1/4 mile time is respectable, but this car's strong points are its handling and highway cruising abilities. Not that it's slow in a drag race either; just drag racing wasn't its intent. The Contour SVT was easily the best handling fwd sport sedan ever available in America until the recent Mazda Protégé, but still beats that car in acceleration.  The car is not perfect, but it does what it was made for very well.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: I have owned this car for four years now and it continues to find new ways to put a big smile on my face!  The great thing is I went from a single guy to a married-with-two-kids guy in the interim and I didn't have to give up the sports car!  There's nothing like smoking 3-Series BMW's with your "lowly" Ford with your two-year old daughter screaming "wheeee" in the back.  Great car, great drive, yeah the stereo was a pain but a quick aftermarket fix put an end to that.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: This is about as close as any american car company has gotten to german engineering quality and performance.  The stock shifter is alot like an 80's honda, but it flies with a short throw replacment.  This car is definately a collector, and I would suggest purchasing one to anyone that has the opportunity.  There are not many of these cars out there, so get them if you can.  The only downfall is the lack of a healthy aftermarket.  It seems that ford built the SVT Conour and then forgot about it.  But many parts for the Cougar are interchangable.

Vehicle_Title: 1998 Ford Contour SVT Sedan 4dr Sedan
Review: as I was driving my new Contour svt home from the dealership the waterpump went! (62K miles) not what I was expecting from a new purchase car.. but they fixed it and it seams to run fine now!

Vehicle_Title: 2017 Ford Flex Wagon Limited 4dr Wagon AWD (3.5L 6cyl 6A)
Review: I am 6'8 and used to have a suburban.  I found that the flex has more head room and the same about of leg space of the suburban.  I liked the suburban, but found the flex road nicer and the seats to be a little more comfortable.   The biggest loss in the flex is cargo room.  The other thing that I wish was a little better was fuel mileage and a bigger gas tank.  But overall I own two of them and we love them.  It is like owning a mini expedition, without the huge costs.

Vehicle_Title: 2017 Ford Flex Wagon SEL 4dr Wagon AWD (3.5L 6cyl 6A)
Review_Title: Itchen to ride in  my flex
Review: Well this is the 3th ford flex that we have owned, We love it  drives beautifully easy to get in and out it is great on trips, really to many good things to mention really a great car with plenty of room for a family of 7, But we like it for a family of 2

Vehicle_Title: 2017 Ford Flex Wagon SEL 4dr Wagon (3.5L 6cyl 6A)
Review: Previous car was a 300 Sedan...which was very low to the ground..like being up for visibility and safety. NEVER owned a Ford before, Flex is the only vehicle that even appealed to me...I must say so far I'm pretty happy. Fuel economy not the greatest and the engine seems a bit small for the large body..but haven't tried to climb any mountains yet. More technology than I will ever use. Missing that refrigerated console that was discontinued but extremely roomy and the Multi Vista Sun Roof is really desirable.

Vehicle_Title: 2014 Ford Flex Wagon Limited 4dr Wagon AWD (3.5L 6cyl 6A)
Review: If you have kids, or are a do-it-yourselfer you will find this vehicle is wonderful.  Plenty of room, the back seats fold down to allow 12-foot lumber to be loaded.  Groceries are no problem and I can even put four gas cans to fill up at the gas station.  Ride is incredible, very smooth, quiet, and handling is exceptional.  The turning radius is not great but is manageable.  The Flex looks like a wagon that it is but is great at so many things I have it give it a five-star overall rating.  If you plan to travel with kids make sure you get the DVD player for the back seat.  The kids can watch movies or even play video games.  Safety features are very good although I wish my model had the adaptive cruise control that is on my 2017 Ford Fusion.  I can't say enough about this little wagon that can!

Vehicle_Title: 2014 Ford Flex Wagon Limited 4dr Wagon AWD (3.5L 6cyl 6A)
