If you test a 2004 and a 2005, you will notice the improvements to the

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab XLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: I have a XLT 250 regular cab 6.2 gas. I have less than 25K and I get this squeaking noise AT TIMES when I turn right or left at any speed.I have taken it to the dealer and they can't find what is causing it.I have bought several Chevy's over the years and my wife talked me into buying this piece of junk.Will NEVER purchase another Ford again.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: The F-250 extra cab long bed is not your ordinary family run around every day kind of ride. That's only because the mpg would deter most families. But if you need to haul, go camping, tow something or just feel safe, this is the truck. The ride and handling is superb. The tech stuff i.e. Bluetooth, phone syn & nav works well to enhance the overall enjoyment of this Cadillac truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: This 2011 6.7 Diesel is powerful, quiet and still gives good fuel economy. The interior is fantastic.  It's functional yet has many features that you'd find in a high end car. I am really impressed with the insync and display functions.  I've gotten several comments from co-workers, envious of this vehicle.  I love this truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: I only  have about 700 Miles On My XLT 4x4 So Far So Good , No Problem, This is My First New Ford truck In About 20 Years , Great Ride , Radio Could Be Better, Blue Tooth Standard Would Be Nice. Fuel Mileage Is At 13.6 MPG

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Only have had my new Powerstroke F250  one week, and just love it!  Getting ready to purchase a slide in camper, so started with the truck first. I definitely won't have any problems with any RV I choose.  This truck is a true workhorse with indescribable power, but still has all the bells and whistles to make you want to drive it every day.  Only have 150 miles on it so far, so can't really assess fuel economy or build quality just yet, but my first impression is great.  I would be surprised if this would change over time.  Very important for me to buy American - built in the Bluegrass State.  Keep up the good work, Ford.  You've got a great vehicle!

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Mixed driving around town and highway the truck, unloaded, operated at 14.2 MPG.  Used the truck on a 3500 mile trip loaded with a slide-in camper - it did not do so well.  Operated at 10.0 to 13.5 MPG depending on terrain and wind conditions.  Struggled with  highway speeds - most times could not maintain highway speed - disappointed with the lack of torque and power.  The drive train needs to be repaired as the universal joints are already sloppy (they clang-ring whenever transmission is put into 'D' or 'R' from 'P').  From all indication the title 'super duty' is a misnomer. Camper weight = 2240 lbs, only a fraction of what FoMoCo advertises the truck can handle.  Pretty sad indeed.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Overall the truck seems fantastic. Comfortable, powerful, quiet, and functional.  Glad to have it.   A couple of concerns.  Went from a 1999 Crew SWB to this 2011 Super Cab LWB. Was counting on using all the space behind the drivers seat, but was surprised to find the woofer for the stereo under the back drivers side seat.  Second issue is that the truck has been unable to move coming out of uphill parking lots, under heavy load (large horse trailer).  Seems to be a tow control issue.  Have to put the truck in park, shutdown, turn back on to get moving.  Ford is looking into the issue, as it is easy to duplicate.  It is stuck in 3rd according to Ford during this failure state.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Nearly 1000 mi so far with no issues.  Great mileage > 20 mpg.  Tows nicely a 10K 5th wheel.  Everyone notices how quiet it is with no smell.  Bed is better with tie downs and built in hitch to frame.  Older 1997 had fold down back seat to flat floor, this model has poor room in the super cab since seats do not fold down-thank the Feds for that.  Outside is nice enough and the suspension and drive feel are more car-like than truck.  Towing with new exhaust brake is excellent and as long as you don't push it up hills, it is great on mpg.  Only neg is $$$$$ for what you get, needs splash guards.  The new display screen is nice with instant mpg, miles to empty etc.  Dodge is less exp. for similar.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Ford has really showed their interest in their customer wants.Here it is at the lights a brand new 300 chrsyler hits his horn and points at the light. I gave him the horn and of course reaction is my middle name , and all the way up to 90 mph he steps out of it side by side. What a rush. Oh the wife was pist but hell it was worth it.The reason for this episode was the truck now has 140000.00 and never once did the ck engine light come on. Went in for a transmission calibration and that was it. Out standing truck. All the bells and whistles. Keep changing the syn. oil every 5000 miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Have purchased a 2004 dodge ram, and 2007 and 2009 chevy silverado and they spent more time in the shop than time on the road. Frankly they were cheap junk. I bought my 2011 and havent had one bit of trouble even tho i was worried about the 6.2 gas engine. The truck pulls my 9,300 lbs camper without any problems. Was concerned about gas milage but its a heavy duty truck which has pulled everything that i have put behind it without any problems! stylish, comfortable and from my past....clearly the best truck on the market!

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: I have 6,000 miles on this truck and have had to replace the turbo, oil cooler and fuel pump. It has a vibration in the engine around 40mph that Ford has been trying to fix for 6 months.This is the best looking truck on the market, the worst reliability and I would never own another one. The regen mode for the emissions is a pain in the neck and the biggest fuel burner. Once going into the Regen mode my mileage drops from 14 mpg to 11mpg in town. Ford is very little help when problems occur.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab King Ranch 4dr Crew Cab 4WD LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Just bought the King Ranch f250 a couple days ago, and it's an incredible truck. I haven't had the chance to tow with it yet, but every element is great so far. My truck was fully loaded at an msrp of $65k, and I don't regret a single penny of it. The ride quality is great, and the vehicle rides very smooth, even when it's unloaded. My fiance is able to drive it easily and loves the interior features. I'm looking forward to hooking up a trailer and taking it on a road trip to the lake.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review_Title: F-250 XLT Crew Cab 6.7 Power Stroke
Review: What a great truck!I have owned several domestic trucks in the past and this truck is my favorite so far.This is my first super duty diesel.I'm 6'6" and I am very comfortable driving it.There is plenty of room and the seat are awesome!It rides nice and the new power stroke is powerful.Ford did a great job with this motor.It's quiet and smokeless.I would definitely recommend this truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review_Title: What an Amazing Truck> Couldn't be happier
Review: This is by far the best truck i've owned.I have been a GM man but with all the issues from my 2008 2500HD diesel i had to try something different.Also, not very happy with the whole government motors thing.Anyway, this truck gets great fuel mileage as i'm seeing 19-20mpg on the hwy and the power is just unreal.Tows my 13K trailer like its a feather.Inside the seats are comfortable and theres so much more room than the GM trucks.I was very hesitant about moving over to Ford but now i'm glad i did.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: I have a 2011 F250 with 2300 miles on it and everything is good except like everyone I would like better that 12.8 MPG.The probelm that I am having is that when I leave from work I have to get to 55 mph right away and on 6 occations (not really pushing it hard) the truck shifts to 2nd and then shifts back to 1st and it feels like it died.This never happens anywhere else.I don't think that it is hurting anything as long as I don't over rev the engine but I am going to attempt to get it fixed.I wonder if antone else has had this problem.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Well it's now been 6 months with my new diesel and it's been great!  The only thing I took the truck in for was an update to flash the truck to 400 hp, 800 ft. lb of torque.  This new diesel has been a major success so far, don't believe some of the negative reviews as they are probably being submitted by competitors. Ford seems to really be on top of this diesel and wants feedback from its customers.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Purchased a 2011 crew cab Lariat with the new 6.7 power stroke. I have put 2500 miles on it so far. Just pulled my 40' fifth wheel on a 300 mile trip. The total weight with trailer and truck was 24,400 lbs. Averaged 10 mpg, the pulling power was amazing as was the new transmission. I set the Cruise at 70 mph and it held it with no problem, very little shifting. My last truck was a 6.0 with a power chip, the new truck wins hands down! The mileage empty is not as good as I had hoped, it gets 16-17 mpg with the Cruise set at 80. I know a few people with these trucks, they will not get the 22+ that people are talking about. Overall a powerful, comfortable truck that drives amazing.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: I took a 1k trip last weekend empty. Set the cruise on 75 and got 15.5 which I'm thinking is a good start since not everything is flat here. On the way back I ran 80+ mph and got into the 13mpg range but can't expect much at that speed. When pulling my 15,000, 4 slide 5th wheel I use the manual shift option and that eliminates any up and down shifting unless I want to and I'm able to maintain a nice power range keeping the tach in the 2200 - 2800 area or wherever I need it. Very satisfied so far. Had a 2005 6.o before.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: I hope everyone's experience with their 6.7L Power Stroke F-250 is as good as mine has been so far, 6 weeks in.  I purchased a 2011 F-250 6.7L PS, 4door, 4wd crew cab FX4, spec'd out and ordered.  I sold my 2008 6.4L Power Stroke (reluctantly) to get the new one.  I say "reluctantly" because it was a great truck with only two areas I would have liked improved--fuel mileage and turbo lag (from a dead stop).  As we say in the South "boys, let me tell ya," Ford improved both and improved them well.  Power and response is nothing short of amazing.  Fuel mileage is 17 mpg in town and 20 mpg hwy (65 mph).  Hwy mileage drops to about 17.5 to 18 mpg at 75 mph and I have 3:55 EL axle with 18" wheels.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Purchased a 2011 F-250 with the new 6.2V8, and 3.73 gears (has a 5th wheel towing capacity of 12,000 lbs). Truck was awesome until I pinned onto my 5th wheel! The vehicle is way underpowered to handle a 10,000 lb trailer. It would shift constantly between 5th and 2nd speed to maintain highway speeds (40 to 55 mph) reaching 5000 rpm at times. Dealer tried the truck himself, and could not believe the lack of torque & HP. He was most helpful by taking the truck back, and ordering a new one with the 4.30 gears. I am hoping it will pull, but am afraid it will be thirsty!

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab King Ranch 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: I bought my new $65k truck 9/06/2010, on 9/21 had smoke boiling up under hood, truck into service 9/24/2011, still have not gotten truck back as of 10/12/2010. The truck has literally been in the shop equal to the number of days I drove it. I have not had my truck for 18 days a counting. Ford refused to take the truck back so now I'm stuck with a truck I'll never feel to be reliable. So much for "Built Ford Tough" . 12 more days and they take it back as a true Lemon. Stay clear!

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: I've got 1300 miles on the truck. Today I used the manual transmission option and to my surprise pulling my 20 foot boat on a tandem trailer, windy and hilly it really did a nice job. Was able to keep the power and rpm where I wanted them. A very pleasant surprise. Great truck. 12 mpg city. About 9 mpg pulling in ugly conditions so far. Rides nice. Seats are softer. Heat and cooling seats are nice in a Lariat. Will be taking it on a 1,000 mile trip in a month to see what the mileage is.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: This truck has been in the shop for a hesitation problem 5 times. They have put computers on it and I had to push a bottom when it was acting up. They tell me it is normal if it is, I want my 2009 DURA MAX back. The only reason I bought it was thanks to [violative content deleted] running GM. The mileage towing my 5th wheel has been getting worse as time goes on. I'm down to about 8.2 mpg. I wish Ford would buy this one back and I WOULD BUY THE CHEVY AGAIN even with Obamby in charge. On one trip my wife and I were going down the highway and a/c turned in to a heater for no reason. This truck is a piece.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Driving the "KING" 250 super duty Lariat (loaded version) for 4100 miles with 6.7 power stroke and find the truck solid as a rock. This is my first Ford truck; driven GMC/Chevy products for years. Over 18 mpg around town and over 19 mpg highway. Trailer towing is cake.  No smoke and no noise for the new scorpion engine. Power up the whazzoo. Six speed transmission is smooth and not overly busy. It's early but have had other new trucks back many times in less miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD LB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: It's a diesel with 6600 miles already on it and I think its a pretty good truck.  Mileage isn't quite as good as I thought it would be, about 14 in town and 18 on the highway. It's 4wd with the 3.55 rear-end, wish it had the 3.31, mileage would be better.  It came with the Ultimate Lariat package which makes it the nicest truck I've ever driven.  There is a bit of an issue with the key/remote, it seems to work when it wants to. Took it on a trip Houston to Dayton, OH and back and it drove great.  At 5500 I had to add some DEF, found it a a truck stop, 2.5 gallon container with a spout for about $15.00.  There was some towing in the first 5500 miles.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Just took delivery two weeks ago. The 6.7 diesel engines just breathes confidence and power. Extremely quiet cabin unlike all other diesels in this class. Averaging 19.5 highway, 16 City. Bought for use with cabover truck camper. Ride is excellent while carrying 2300 lb payload. Very little sway and averaged 14.5 mpg over 300 mile trip loaded. A great truck, excellent seats and interior cabin design. This is a smart truck. Study the owner's manual to enjoy all the features, especially the navigation system.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review_Title: First Super Duty.  Love this truck
Review: Exceptional vehicle.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: It's really early in the game to call this thing a success yet, but wow!  This truck has incredible power, interior is better than any out there.  My biggest concern was powertrain reliability and fuel economy.  The latter is showing around 19 on the highway, city driving around 16.  I'll have to wait to see how she holds up.  So far, awesome!

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: Just found out after buying a 60,000 dollar 2011 superduty that i cannot mount any 5th wheel or goose neck hitch at this time. on a short bed this is through my dealership talking to ford engineers. they are working on the problem. please alert potential buyers now.

Vehicle_Title: 2011 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (6.2L 8cyl 6A)
Review: just picked up this behemoth yesterday drove to okc today 300 miles on diesel fuel range 16-17.4 mpg at 70.You can feel the power and build quality of this vehicle. people just stare.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab XL 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I am a Ford Truck person with having several over the years. the problem I have with them living in SW pa. is the RUST. The wheel lips on the bed have always been a area of concern. With this 250 I park it in a garage and keep it clean but it didn't make a difference. the only option is to buy a southern bed or get rid of the truck. My next move is to move to the F-350 diesel. I presently use this truck to move a 6600 lb skid steer and with the 5.4 it is a dog on any grade. I am happy that the mech. part has given me no problems but I think a heaver truck will satisify my req. I will buy another FORD

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab XLT 2WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: The 5.4 Triton V-8 and the V-10 are blowing out spark plugs thru out the USA.  If you google this problem you will find out there are only 3 threads for the spark plug to grip to and the heads are aluminum.  Sorry no fix as a heli-coil is made of steel and it heats up ar a different temperature than aluminum, then the heli-coil also blows out.  This happens on Ford super duty trucks from 1999 thru 2005,  Be careful not to purchase this poorly engineered garbage.  Dont believe me?  Google it! ~!!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab XL 2WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck is awesome! It is awesome for off roading due to its ground clearance and 4.10 gears. If only it had the power of Chevy's 6.0 v8.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab XL 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Currently have about 48,000 miles on this truck.  Power is adequate.  Mileage is great.  Gets about 18 mpg highway.  Not bad for a 4WD 3/4 ton. Haven't had any trouble with this truck yet other than an ABS light coming on and off recently. I dont like the way the truck handles on the highway. Ford redid their front suspension on their 2005 models though.  Much better! Good clearance for off road.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab XLT 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Other than the new transmission, transfer case, front wheel bearings, air bag parts, oxygen sensor and bad fuel mileage this is a great truck.  Perofrmance wise it is great, although it does squat pretty bad with a full load on the back.  I have a fisher 8' plow on the front and salt spreader on the back which the truck handles great.  The fuel mileage is about 10- 11 mpg local 13 highway (with a 4:10 rear).  If this truck had not given me so many reliabilty issues I would put up with the mileage but I feel Ford has failed on this one.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab XL 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Unloaded, this pickup rides so stiff it's uncomfortable.  Gas mileage on the V-8, A/T is 14 on the road, 10 hauling an antique car on a trailer.  The power is sufficient, but that's about all.  Now for the good stuff:  It's surprisingly good in the mud in 4WD.  This is a reliable, rattle free pickup.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab 2dr Regular Cab XLT 2WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: 7.3 Power Stroke is a work horse. Truckstarts in hot or cold weather, great fuel economy for that size rig

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Lariat, leather, 4x4, V-10, bucket power seats, power everything for that matter, HUGE...needed a megaphone to talk to the people riding with me I had so much room!  This truck is the best truck I have ever owned. I am 6'5", 300 lbs.  I have 56" shoulders.  I have never ridden in another vehicle that I could actually feel comfortable. 12,000 lb trailer, no problem.  Missing a gas station. HUGE problem.  I live in -20 to -30 below temps.  Warm up, 4x4, terrible gas mileage, 4-6 mpg for the winter.  Up to 17.3 mpg at 60 on cruise and wind behind me going downhill.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Original owner. I love the color the ride every thing.  At 20000 miles the tires crap out. They put cheap tires on to keep the price down. At fifty thousand the front end goes out.  $3000 dollars worth. This is after a trip to Indiana from Iowa on interstate going 80 mph. Now keep in mind this heavey duty truck has never worked a day in its life. About two weeks later the tranny just quit. Guess what?  Warranty never covered a thing.  Now there has been some small stuff too but all in all I feel an expensive truck for the way I drive and use it.  Now at 100000 front end and tranny need replaced again. I traded in 1984 Chevy.  I'm going back to Chevy.  Last thing 14.5 mpg every time.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 2WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This Ford truck is the best one I have owned. It is comfortable to drive, especially when towing. I use it to tow a 30' Kountry Starr 5th. wheel and you never know it is back there. I have been getting about 9.0 to 10.0 miles/gal. towing and 15 to 16.5 not towing.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: So far I am very pleased with my truck. It gets reasonable fuel mileage- -20 mpg highway and 17 to 18 mpg around town if I drive conservatively. I have taken several long trips in it and the captain chairs are very comfortable. The 6 speed detracts from the fun of driving it. The only problem I had was with the hydraulic clutch assembly, which my son replaced. Right now I am having a problem with the door locks, but apparently that is not uncommon.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Had a $40 part go out of my tranny at 57,000 miles.  That was the only problem I have had mechanically.  Mileage is 7-10 mpg in the winter and 11- 15 in the summer for combined highway and city.  I have the V-10.  Lots of power and the Lariat heated leather seats are amazing.  I am 6'5" and have room to spare.  Very nice.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 2WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is a great truck. Yes, it has a stiff ride. No, it doesn't get great gas mileage (although it's as good as my '96 F150 got, so I'm not complaining). It's a heavy duty truck, not your grandmother's Buick. It is built to work and work hard and it does that incredibly well. The 5.4L has more than enough power and torque to do any job the average homeowner has. Although it is built to work, it is still comfortable and stylish enough to take out on the town, although parking might be tricky in some lots. On and off road manners are more than acceptable for a truck of this size. Besides all that, it just looks so cool!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XL 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Good dependable truck.  Made to work hard.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 2WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Awesome power, good fuel economy. I have pulled 10,000 lb. trailers, hauled welding machines, dirt and rock, never got it to breathing hard. Couple of mechanical issues - AC compressor, and camshaft position sensor.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 2WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have been a Ford man since day one. Since I purchased my F-250 in 2003, I have had the O rings replaced in the turbo 3 times, various oil leaks taken care of by the dealer, the rear end had a friction modifier installed to cure the slipping when going around corners, and now at 72,000 miles the transmission went. The dealer says Ford knows about the transmission problems, but wont recall them, or help owners with them. I just spent $2,700 rebuilding the transmission with aftermarket heavy duty parts; the transmission shop says the Ford parts are garbage (Ford wanted $ 3000.00 with stock parts) Quality is Job one! Nice catchy slogan, too bad they dont mean it. Cant wait to get rid of it.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XL 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I owned a 1986 Ford F-250 Diesel. It has lasted 13 years with me. It had 300,000 miles on it and was still going strong. But I needed a newer truck. Looked for months; couldn't find one until I found a F-250 Powerstroke diesel. I am getting around 18 mpg. It is great going back and forth from work. Rides great, feels sturdy and feels like it is always going to stay on the road. I didn't get the shift on the fly because I go offroad a lot and work in construction. The diesel engine runs great and has a lot of power  and it is nice to have a turbo on the engine.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 2WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: So far its been a great truck, I have been getting alot of remarks about how wonderful my truck looks. I love the power of this vehicle.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 2WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This has been a great truck! It is fire-engine red with a matching shell that makes it all look like a customized "expedition" and it runs as good as it looks. People are stopping me and asking about it all the time. I am extremely happy that I bought it. Pulling a travel trailer with a headwind can be awful on gas mileage tho. 12 mpg in town, 15-18 hwy and 6-9 towing 7k lbs. Well worth the extra money for gas because it IS so reliable.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XL 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Wonderful truck to own.  Great power

column1: but very poor mileage.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: 2001 F-250 Crew Lariat SB Pwr Stk NICE!
Review: Traded a 2002 Dodge Ram 2500 Quadbcab Cummins DSL for 2001 F-250 Crew Lariat 7.3 Powerstroke straight up.  I am doing less masonry and more white collar stuff. Dodge was dynamic and strong, but loud and awkward for a father with 3 boys.  Interior - Going from the Dodge to the Ford was like going from a closet to a living room.  The Ford build quality and attention to detail is far superior to the Dodge. The Ford is quieter, more stable and seems better rooted to the road. Its like an SUV on steroids.  Exterior - Ford's body lines are cleaner, the hinges tighter and the little things, like a light under the hood and a locking tailgate, are much appreciated.  Very glad I made that trade!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 2WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is the BEST truck I have ever owned. It has a V-10 that has NEVER left me stranded! I love this truck and hate to get rid of it but it has over 300000 miles!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I really enjoy this truck! I have been a Ford man for a really long time( 6th Ford truck) Interior is really nice, with tan leather, heated seats, lots of storage, and just roomy all around. Bought truck for hauling, and looking good while doing it. It accomplishes both with ease. I am not getting the best gas mileage right now, but i believe the transmission is a little worn out. Expected with a vehicle that has 129,000 miles on it! That is really my only complaint. Rides a lot nicer than i thought, being a vehicle with leaf springs up front. Love it!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have the 7.3 PowerStroke. WHAT A POWERHOUSE! I pull a 9000lb. fifth wheel with about 2000 lbs in water, accessories and it doesn't even struggle. I have added an aftermarket air filter and also have a programmer for the computer. I don't need the extra power but when is enough,enough? This truck will light them up on all 4 wheels. 120+ extra hp.  I'd like to get a hold of the 08' with the new 6.4L diesel. With 24,000lb. towing capacity you can make every home a mobile home.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 2WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This is my first BIG truck and I love it.  We bought it used with around 70,000 miles on it and after the alternator went out the first week, we have had no problems whatsoever.  It is awesome pulling a horse trailer and doesn't get bogged down for much.  Love the way it handles and we actually get really good gas mileage, around 19 in town and 25 or better on the highway.  It is not a 4x4 and have no aftermarket changes to it.  I was raised a Chevy girl, but am so very impressed with my Ford.  Maybe there is room out there for both. :o)

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: Outstanding vehicle in every way. 12-13 mpg city/highway with 6.8L and 3:73 non limited slip rear. Best mileage at 16 mpg empty on open road at 60 mph. Motor has plenty of power and is good choice if diesel is not an option. Motor is strong at 97k, burns 1/3 to 1/2 quart between 4k oil changes. I will look to replace it with similar options. Thanks Ford!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XL 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review_Title: What a woman thinks of her truck
Review: I LOVE this Truck! It has been a much better experience than the two Toyotas, a Ford F-150 or the two Dodge trucks I've owned. It is a V-10 and I have very few complaints about it. I would recommend this truck to anyone who needs a heavy duty truck. A lot of people ask why I drive such a large truck, and I must reply that I never have to ask anyone to help me move something or go to the dump with yard waste.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 2WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: This truck pulls an 11,500 pound trailer - it has pulled it through the Appalachians, the Black Hills, and the Big Horn Mountains without any trouble whatsoever.  It exudes power.  It has been trouble free for 71,000 miles and has many many more trouble free miles left in it.  What a great truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 2WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I've had this truck since May of 2001.I've never had any reliability issues and it does any thing I want to do.I pull a 26ft trailer all over the country and the power of the V10 is more than one really needs. The mileage isn't too bad for a truck of this size with a big engine,10mpg city and 16 to 18 on the road.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I've had this truck for over 3 yrs now and so far the only problems that I've had are a bad COP and I've had to have the 4x4 hubs replaced under warranty.  I've heard problems with the tranny and spark plugs but thus far have not had any of those problems.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 2WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have had this truck for nearly 4 years, and have not had any reliability issues with it.  It has pulled our 10,500 pound travel trailer from Georgia to Montana and Wyoming, and to Maine.  It has always performed superbly.  I get decent fuel mileage when not pulling - usually about 16-17 in town, but I do avoid all the lights. On the highway I have gotten anywhere from 18 to an incredible 27 mpg (that only happened once - usually the upper limit is 22mpg). Pulling the trailer it gets around 12mpg - except on 8% grades, where it drops about 2mpg.  I wouldn't buy another one because I don't plan on ever getting rid of this one!

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: At 36,720 miles the transmission gave out leaving me on I-85. Now at 59,014 miles the drivers side front wheel hub is missed up. I call Ford 3-times and  finally was told that the repair is not covered under my extended warranty.  The service manager at the dealership never called me after FCC said he would. The truck pulled to right from day one and you can't adjust it. My tailgate has alway been hard to open and there is a clunking sound from passenger front that I have never found out what it is.  My tires wore out at 30,000 miles and have been rotated every 3,000 miles from day one. Please tell everyone about my experiences.

Vehicle_Title: 2001 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 5M)
Review: I have had no trouble in 15 month's and 13,800 miles.  The mileage from the powerstroke gets better as more miles are run up. I have been disappointed in the paint on my vehicle.  Excellent visibility from the elevated driving position and the headlights.  DO NOT buy one without foglights.  I cannot say enough about the powerstroke.  What a fine piece of engineering.  I have put in a K&N filter and will go to a chip in the next few months.  I have been getting 18mpg on the road and expect that to keep getting better. Diesel is strong in 4 wheel drive and I have yet to get stuck on my hunting lease.  Tires will spin easily even on dry pavement though.

V10 But oh my Gawd this engine is as smooth as a baby's bottom with fresh talcum powder on it. The truck is truely amazing. I love it! The ride is nice and smooth, the interior is nice and comfortable, the suspension is strong as an ox and the power to pull is overwhelming. Great truck!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: First and foremost,  DO NOT BUY A FORD WITH A 5.4L ENGINE.  5.4 l engines Ford used are notorious for blowing head gaskets like mine did at around 75, 000 miles. Also, due to the aluminum block, the spark plugs have a reported habit of either falling into the cylinders or shooting out. This engine is crap and expensive to repair.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XL Rwd LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: The BEST of the BEASTS! Love my truck!
Review: Bought my f250 RWD XL Utility Truck back in 2012 for a song and at 270,000km/168,000mi she is still going strong!!! She is a little ugly from the previous owner but the engine purrs like new, the interior is still in great shape and there is virtually no rust on the body! I have fallen in love with Ford trucks. Simply awesome and easy to fix!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Still going strong!  No major issues with this truck.  I replaced brakes, end links, alternator, ball joints only.  Interior is quiet with no squeeks or rattles.  Exterior is in great shape with no corrosion.  Engine efficiency is lower than when new and acceleration is a bit slower.  Power is still very strong.  Feels solid, strong and safe.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought the truck used back in '05.  The previous owner must have had the engine injectors and turbo changed (a common problem with the first 6.0l diesels), because this thing has been a powerhouse for me, never a problem. Now that its getting older, and has 100,000 miles, I am still pulling horse trailers, and loving the power.  My only qualm is a weird rattle from the frame SOMEWHERE (can't seem to find it when not moving). I couldn't be happier with the truck, and will probably hold onto it for another 3 years, then give it to my daughter as her first vehicle (she can pull her own horse trailer then!).

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XL Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have a 7.3 diesel. It's a wonderful hauler! The truck is very stable when hauling 2 yards of dirt or our 5th wheel trailer. I haven't modified the powertrain and see no need to. The economy of the diesel is about 14 in town and 19 highway; and about 11 with the trailer. Top build quality, over 100,000 miles and no squeaks. If you need to move heavy stuff, this is the one. If you only want a truck to look cool, the half-tonners are better for that. This is a serious work truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I own a '03 7.3L powerstroke, at the lake the transmission went out with only 52,000 miles on it. I took it to the dealer figuring the 100,000 mi powertrain warranty would cover it, it didn't. $ 4,000 later and the new transmission (refurbished I add) has a better warranty than the origional one. I'm dissapointed when I pull 14000K worth of equipment. I've heard wonderful things but haven't experienced the greatness of the 7.3L. Soon trade for a new twin turbo F-350 or a Dodge Cummins

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT Rwd LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: My truck has been in the shop 21 times, 12 loaner cars, 5 repeats from local dealership and two tow trucks. Ford customer service is just at bad. This is the worst truck ford has ever made. Buy anything but the 6.0 Ford. Should this qualify for a lemon? Ford thinks not. Be careful and look for something else.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Only a Ford can be this Good
Review: Writing this 4 years into ownership, I have to say I can't believe Ford can build such an outstanding product. My truck has been flawless - has never needed anything other than routine maintenance... which after 4 years has totaled around $1000.00.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: 7.3 liter diesel with 122,000 trouble free miles and it still looks and runs like new.  This truck still has its original rotors and pads which aren't even half worn out!  18 mpg at the speed limit with the comfort of a car and out of this world torque.  Pulled an 8,000 lb boat coast to coast without breaking a sweat.  Torque converter could lockup a little tighter.  4WD is there when you need it.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Bought the truck a few weeks ago and I LOVE it!  Traded in a F-150 with the 4.2L V6 for a F-250 with 5.4L V8.  Maybe a little underpowered for such a big truck but it is still very fun to drive.  Fuel mileage is ok but not the greatest, probably the only reason I like having the V8 instead of the V10.  Go with a diesel even though it costs a lot more.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: My 2004 PSD F-250 has been in repair for 50% of the time with transmission and accelerator control problems, including an accident caused by loss of accelerator control.   It has had a new wiring harness, two new computers, a rebuilt transmission, new accelerator pedal, engine sleeve, and other issues, and now needs a new transmission that Ford says will take 70 days to deliver.  My F-250 SD has been a nightmare to own, and Ford has been virtually non-responsive to my complaints. Their customer interface stinks, to but it nicely.  I almost never tow with this truck, never take it off road, and never abuse it, yet the transmission failed three times. Once minor, twice major.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my third Ford truck and they just keep getting better. The only regret that I have is that I did not buy one with the V-10 or diesel, instead of the 5.4 V-8. It runs great until you tow a trailer with it. Then you have to disable the overdrive and suffer the loss of gas mileage. I get about 13 in town and 16 highway, empty, but only about 9 towing our small 21' camper. My friend's F-350 with 7.3L gets over 15mpg towing nearly anything.I feel a 2005 diesel and Tow Command in my near future ! Ford Credit, here I come again!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XL 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I Love my truck. It is quiet and does the job it was designed to do. No frills, no leather, it is a truck. The shocks are too soft and I replaced them with heavier ones. Other than that the only bad thing about this vehicle is the gas mileage.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is a GREAT TRUCK!  I had to have the injectors replaced before 500 miles, but since then not a problem one!!!  I have changed the oil, had the most recent computer upgrades installed, and driven it with a big smile on my face.  It pulls my travel trailer as if I were driving unloaded.  I can't find a single thing I don't like about this truck!  The mileage is good and the 6.0 PSD and automatic torqshift work great together.  Off road it has great clearance and even stock is competent.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: nothing short of a great truck.fuel

column1: mileage is unbelievable!these trucks
are really made to work.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I use this truck primarily to pull a travel trailer.  The 6.0 PSD is a great engine and I love the TorqShift automatic, they really work great together.  Two of my brothers have 7.3 PSDs that are chipped and both have driven my 6.0 and reflect on the difference in power.  In a simple phrase, I love it!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my fourth f250 i had two diesels and 2 5.4 v8. my previous 5.4 v8 got 16 on the highway. this new one only gets about 8, it has 410 gears. sume what disappointed.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XL 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: We have 2 other Fords. We upgraged from a 1986 truck to the new Diesel Powerstroke, Super Duty 4x4 short bed. It has the 6.0 liter engine and 5 speed trans. Wow what a truck. It has plenty of power and speed in reserve when you need it. The ride is great and the fuel economy gets better with each tank. It feels like a town car compared to the old truck. Looks great with color matched topper.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: If u want a truck with power and a whole lot of torque this is the truck to by. this truck could tow other trucks down the street like nothing, last winter i was blocked in my drive-way by the 3-4 feet of snow the snow plows piled up, i just put it in 4x4 high floored it and it went right through it like nothing u can feel it cral right through it. the one thing i dont really like about it is when your on the highway and u just feel like speeding the truck starts to slow down at 97 mph, i guess the trucks made for power not speed. but if u want a whole lot of power this is the truck to bye.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I purchased this truck new on 06/30/2003 and within less than 200 miles the thing started to squeek and rattle something terrible. The doors rub on the weather strip making a nasty sound, the windows rattle if they are up or down. If the windows are down they clang in the doors. The entire body structure groans when you make a turn. Terrible truck for $36,000.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have driven all 3 makers H.D. TRUCKSPriced them all, and found that FORDhas the best bang for my buck....I ordered it from the factory and it wasdelivered in about 4 weeks...

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have a 2003 f250 supercab longbed 4x4 offroad and the sport package. Everything on the truck is black even the interior. I love that it is all black. It rides like a cadillac and has alot of power. I love that it sits high but I feel the mirrors stick out to far are going to hit something on the side of the road. Fuel miliage could be better,but I sure dont want a bigger tank, it takes long enough to fill up now(38 gallon). Don't go to park in a small parking lot,it is hard to do with the supercab,longbed and 4x4(no turning radious). I won't trade my F250 for the world!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Unfortunately, there was no other engine option to choose from on this review site.  I hace he new 6.0L Diesel and 5-speed automatic.  This truck will change your mind about diesels forever.  I'm amazed at the amount of incredibly smooth, quiet, and most of all powerfull this thing is.   I tossed the stock shocks and put on a set of Bilsteins as well as a set of Centramatic continuous wheel balancers.   I also added a white Glastite GT2000 shell and to match the body color and with the additional weight, the ride is as good as the 99 Grand Marquis which this truck replaced. The truck is simply beautiful.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)

available heavy-duty trucks.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT Rwd LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The truck is stylish enough to take the wife out, yet tough enough to haul the heaviest of loads.  I own a construction company so it's nice to have the power with comfort.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Excellent truck! Looks awesome!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I like the comfort and the mechanical performance.  The diesel, even with a manual trans mission, has power when it's needed.  I had a problem with the tail gate denting when someone jumped onto it from a loading dock, carrying a 50 lb. feed bag.  It just doesn't seem as sturdy as my '78 F150.  The depth of this tailgate is wider but has no reinforcement in it to prevent it from collapsing under weight.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab 4dr SuperCab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have driven pick up truck for most of my adult life and have had three Fords.  So far the F-250, 7.3L, Lariat has been the best of the lot when it comes to perfomance, comfort, ride, style and just plain mojo.  It looks like a truck, rides, like a truck, pulls like a semi but gets great fuel(diesel) mileage. My last truck, an F-150 supercab, gas, ran for almost 235,000 miles before I sold it so it remains to be seen if the F-250 is that durable and reliable.  We will see if Ford still builds their trucks "Ford Tough" or it is just a bunch of hype and hot air.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Best heavy duty truck you can get
Review: We got one of the last 7.3 liter Power Stroke diesel models in the 2003 model year before Ford switched to the 6.0L. We bought the truck new, and we now have 174,000 miles on it. We have had zero powertrain issues, and the only electrical issues we have had were with the alternator failing (once), the ABS module failing (again, once), and a shift-on-the-fly 4WD issue (only once). This truck has plenty of power to do anything. I have pulled people out of ditches and up hills in the snow with this truck. Just lock the diffs and go. We have hauled our truck camper and towed our boat at the same time, and the truck handles it just fine.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT Rwd LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I use this truck for towing my boat to the river and for taking my baseball gear to practice (sons team). I love the truck. I installed headers and exhaust but did not help mileage much. I have a 6 inch lift and 35" tires and get 9-10 mpg. This is my only grievance with this truck but I drive it seldom so not such a big deal. Great truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Loved this truck, performance was great. Used to call it my big sports car. Never had any mechanical issues at all, how ever it chewed thru tires once a year in the front end. Power when needed and a soft relaxing ride. I would buy another in a heart beat. The V-10 drank the gas like it was going out of style in the city but on the highway it was fair.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I like the power of the 6.0 diesel but the turbo and injector were replaced under warranty.  The most annoying problem is the steering wobble.  Truck wanders from side to side on the straight aways.  If anyone has any ideas on a solution for this I would love to know.  So far this is my 1st F250 for my business fleet and it will probably be the last.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought the truck 2 weeks ago. I have been a Chevy at heart (boy did I hear it) and this truck is great. The fuel tank is my only complaint as it is small (27 gallons) at 14.5 mpg around town. Plenty of torque around town and plenty of horsepower for the highway. Haven't used the 4x4 yet, but I will soon! =) Stop looking and buy it. I got the 7.3l and am glad I did.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT Rwd LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: My first crew cab, long bed, F-250. Recently had misfortune of a driver's side impact by a mini van doing better than 60. I was spun and the driver's door came into the seat. I walked away with some bruises, that's all. I'm ordering a 2006 just like the 2003. No additions or subtractions. Excellent built, excellent ride and performance.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love the 6.0l. Never had any problem.  I heard alot of negative talk about this at first.  That's just the anti-ford people talking.  Great engine, more torque, great trans, quieter and cheaper to modify than chevy or dodge.  Ford is simply the best.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Purchased New Had One Week Back in shop motor lost power 6.0 Diesel not good motor at all the 7.3 was better, the body feels cheap, loud road noise, should have purchased Chevy with Duramax/ Allision I went and drove one the other day thinking about trading Ford in  for Chevy, but can not get good trade-in value on Ford!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I hoped buying late into the series production years would help with quality but I am dissappointed. In 38,000 I have been down three times. First ignition coil would not heat up, then both batteries died, and 5,000 miles later the alternator goes bad. All would have put me on the side of the road if I were away from home. The CD player went bad too but that is relatively minor.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: 22.6 MPG on road!  16.6 MPG mixed driving.  You must get the 6.0 diesel, it's the BOSS!  Hugh interior.  Nice riding truck.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I drive this truck approx. 200 miles a day 6 days a week.  It has plenty of power and plenty of room.  I average 21 to 24 mpg on powerstroke 6 liter diesel.I went though a Dodge Dakota quad cab, which was a good small truck,then a Chev.Silverado, which was very uncomfortable, and now this Ford is the truck of my dreams. I have no regrets in buying this truck it is excellent.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This truck is a bulldog in the snow, it handles well.I'm a woman and I love the way this truck handles,the room is unbeliveable. I can haul passengers and tow all of our Harley's. Ford did a great job.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I was lucky enough to find a 2003 F-250 SD with the Powerstroke 6.0 and Torqshift tranny. This truck is just as comfortable going out on the town as it is hauling 14,000 lbs. The only downside, from a performance standpoint, is the cat converter (which first became a requirement in '03). Aside from that, I can't see any reason to purchase another heavy heavy-duty truck..... sorry GM & Dodge.

Review: I have had one reflash (mfg recall) and an ecg valve replaced in 22500  miles. mileage is 17-20 mpg, depending on how I drive it. I have the 6.0L diesel and fx4 package. I love it, tons of power for towing, stable at 85 mph, and people get out of my way. Highly recommend it.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: THIS TRUCK IS OFF THE HOOK
Review: Have a 85 Ford F-250 XL work truck with 150,000 miles and it is still kicking. Bought a new 2003 Ford F-250 Crew Cab, Lariat, Centenial, with the 6.0 liter V8 Turbo Diesel. This truck is fabulous! Took it on the road Last week to Rhode Island and the ride was enjoyable even without a load. The sound system fills the cab with low distortion even music. The 6.0 Turbo Diesel has lots of power and gets good gas mileage, about 18 city and 23 highway. I have the FX4 package and can't wait to see what it can do off-road. I also have a automatic moonroof that fills the cabin with drenched sunlight. This is the most luxurious pick-up that I have ever seen.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT Rwd SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is my 3rd PSD since 99 and it is

auto tranny is incredibly strong and

with the cruise set at 80.  The only

mirrors.  At least in the south Ford

months so they have outstanding resale
compared to a Duramax or Cummins.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: F250 w/ 7.3 L Diesel is a WINNER!!!
Review: Powertrain is a proven winner.  7.3L Power Stroke is hands down the best light duty diesel every produced.  Auto transmission is ultra smooth and distributes power well from the diesel.  Crew cab interior room is phenominal.  Payload and towing capacities are great.  XLT Sport package is great.  Chrome step bars are a great accent.  Sound system rocks.  No problems yet.  GREAT fuel economy with the Diesel.  I could have had the 6.0L CAT Diesel, but decided to go with the proven KING of diesel, the 7.3L.    The 6.0L CAT has some big shoes to fill.  BUY THIS TRUCK.  Traded in my 2002 Dodge Ram (JUNK) for it.  Have never looked back!!!

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Have had the vehicle for seven months and have 15,000 miles to date.  Fantastic comfort, incredible towing, great capacity . . . the perfect truck for any situation.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab Lariat 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This is a great truck.  It has everything that I was looking for.  Ford scored high with this truck.  I have owned F150's and K2500's, this truck by far is superior in all aspects.

Vehicle_Title: 2003 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab 4dr Crew Cab XLT 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: This truck has creamed the competition for me.  I used to be a die-hard Chevy man, but this is in a completely different class.  The ride is smooth with incredible power.  Did I say it has power?  What an understatement!   The comfort is a real surprise.  My wife was used to riding in my Chevy and was a little reluctant to even ride with me in this BIG truck.  She is looking over my shoulder telling me to make sure people understand the comfort.  I have the PowerStroke engine, and, surprisingly, it is quiet enough for my 3 week old son to sleep in.  I highly recommend this vehicle!!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab XLT 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Good truck, gas mileage terrible!!!! Having trouble with right front brake dragging (rim gets coal black in 1000 miles), 2 dealers both refusing to make repairs "can't get paid from Ford, because it'snot bad enough). Ford's 800# customer service is very bad,they just want to get you off the phone. I guess I'll have to pay for repair myself despite the warranty.  I will never buy another Ford!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab XL 2dr Regular Cab LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The truck rides rough. You feel every bump in the road and on the tracks. The truck will lag at acceleration. If you try to pass a slow moving vehicle or enter the highway, the truck's RPMs will lug and you have to pull over so you don't cause an accident. The truck's steering wheel doesn't move up or down to make the cluster visible. The seat is a simple bench seat, so if you have to move the seat forward or backwards you the passenger isn't comfortable. Gas mileage isn't up to par. I maybe getting 12-13MPG at best. If you need a new truck buy a Chevy.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab XL 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought it for a work truck, it has a fisher plow, and it's absolutely the best truck I've ever had. My only complaint is the cheap plastic strip at the top of the tailgate which I've broken twice in under a year, loading bikes and sleds. otherwise I think ford got it right this time!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab XL 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Driveability - abysmally dangerous. The engine decelerates at irregular, random rates making shifting incredibly challenging. Shifts on flat road may take up to 5 seconds to complete (on uphill grades, they might only be done by slipping the clutch). Truck will accelerate by itself to over 2500RPM even in gear. Engine braking is negligible and may turn into acceleration. Dealer says this is normal. The shifter Low/Reverse lockout works sporadically. The fuel tank sloshes when over half-full (sounds like a loose baffle). Truck is taller than the 6'8" specs so wont fit in most garages. Fuel hog despite advanced technology. Engine vibrates. Roof drains into open door or window, onto switches!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab XL 2dr Regular Cab LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Great truck for pulling a trailer. Far superior to any Chevy truck I ever owned. Comfortable, looks great, rides nice, quiet (for a diesel), but I'm getting 9 mpg currently.  Hoping for more as I add more miles to the odometer.  At $4/gallon for diesel these days, who can afford to drive one of these bad boys?

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab XL 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Averaging 10-11 mpg mostly freeway driving. Exhaust billows out of tailpipe on cold mornings. 10k miles and the interior squeaks while on-road driving. Window leaks water and air whistles when rolled up. Currently have an exhaust problem - blue smoke comes out during engine warm up and leaves traffic behind me in a cloud.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Regular Cab XL 2dr Regular Cab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The company assigned this vehicle to me - bare bones XL Long Box 4x4 with the Powerstroke. I put the first 5000 miles on it and must say overall I love it! I ranked the interior lower because it's an XL with the plastic seats and zero options. I'd love a Lariat. The Powerstroke feels like it can tow a house and it is quick when it needs to be (after slight turbo lag). The suspension is set up to be loaded with 2000 lbs, so at freeway speed unloaded, it is "bouncy". I have climbed rocky slopes with a 6000lb trailer hooked up without even needing 4x4. This truck is a beast! Visibility is great for such a large truck. You're going to have to pay for the big rig in gas though...

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I own a 2008 F250 turbo diesel Ford. It is the worst truck that Ford has ever made. I am on my third motor, with only 30,000 miles. That's right 30k miles. absolute garbage motor. The 1st motor blew up at 15 K. the 2nd went at 20 K .The 3rd at 29K. I obviously don't drive this truck hard or a lot; so there is no reason for motor failures. It has so many repair items documented by Carfax that I can't sell it without a huge loss of money. Stay away from the 6.4 turbo diesel. Ford mechanics admit that it is junk(off the record of course) I finally sold it and took a 10k loss.  Good riddance

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XL 4dr SuperCab SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I purchased my 2008 ford Super duty in 2007, One of the first. I now have 218,000 on the 5.4 gas engine. Only 1 set of brakes. New alternator at 100,000 mls. I am a stone mason and work my truck hard. Around 120,000 mls the truck made a engine noise when I started it, almost 100,000 mls later I have the same noise. No change, I always change my oil, I love my truck, Would never buy anything but a ford truck period!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: 2008 F-250 Super Duty 6.4 Desial Super Cab Great Vehicle After Non Factory Additions
Review: I bought this vehicle used in 2009 with 32,000 miles in the XLT trim.  The vehicle had a bad front end and lousey fuel mileage.  I knew this when I purchased the vehicle.  I have invested in a chip to improve fuel mileage along with a banks air filter and magpro exhaust system which improved fuel mileage from 12 to 18/20 mph. Different tires also helped improve fuel mileage. I installed heavy duty air shocks and replaced the front springs with heaover springs and stabilizer bar to the front end.  I also installed side step bars, tool box, backup camera, fog lights and trailer brake and other items.  This was cheaper than buying a more expensive vehicle from the dealer

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XL 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: the worst riding truck ever owned just hit 85000 miles needed tune up 7 of the 8 spark plugs stuck in the head and broke mechanic had to buy special tool they say some are charging up to 1200.00 for tune up got to get rid of it before next tune up

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I put a Bank's toaner on it to improve fuel mileage and the dealership blames everything that goes wrong on the tuner.  I had to take it off.  With the tuner I got 21+ mpg hwy, 18mpg in town.  Without tuner 12.5 Hwy., 8.5 around town.  I do not understand why ford won't offer something that can improve the mpg.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: After 3 recalls a driver door handle that fell off, water seperator going bad, and a rattle in my driver door I still love this truck. The king ranch pkg is excellent and the truck still looks like new after 60,000 miles. Engine has been bullet proof with excellent power. Gas milage for a big truck is good at 18 with no AC or 15.5 with the AC on.PS the rattle in the door was fixed by a simple piece of electrical tape applied to the door latch post where the door meets the frame. This is a nice addition to my $50,000 plus truck LOL!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Just got a used 2008 f250, w/ turbodiesel engine.  Blast to drive. Unending loads of power.  Drags my travel trailer around like its not even there. Built in brake controller great.  Power towing mirrors are a dream.  Quietest diesel engine I have ever heard.  Don't bother with gas engine.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XL 4dr SuperCab SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Really folks this is a great truck and even better if you do some very minor tweaks. There is lag when you want to pass someone. Ford put that "feature" there to preserve the life of the transmission. The gas mileage stinks becase the EPA said we needed cleaner burning engines.. oh the irony. You can feel bumps more compared to chevy. Chevy uses IFS on the front end and when that chevy IFS breaks, then you see the reason ford stuck by solid front and rear axles. With one modification you can increase your HP and Torque by 50%, have 100% throttle control when passing, and improve your MPG by 30%.  You can do this by buying a tuner for about $1500.00. Check out a diesel forum and you'll see.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have a 08 250 6.4  great power. I move up from a f150, not because of power. Braking was not the best when towing 7500 lbs. Now with bigger brakes & controler it's on.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab FX4 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: No problems so far. Diesel is not for the economy minded as this is a heavy vehicle not to mention all the new emission controls the engine has to deal with. Feels solid as a tank. Very happy with purchase.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love this truck for it's appearance both inside and out. My wife has an 06 Acura RL and I will put the interior of this truck against the comfort of her car any day. That said, I am averaging 11 MPG and already have 23K on the trck. I'm told that this will improve once north of 25K but am not holding my breath. Simply put, the fuel economy on this truck stinks! If fuel economy is something that you are looking for in a heavy duty truck, look elsewhere.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have owned this truck for 10 months now and could not be more pleased. Power is great I pull a 34 foot Prowler Regal 5th and often a 17 foot boat behind that and average 13 to 14 miles per gallon (Canada) and 22 to 24 on the highway. I would not complain about poor milage even if it was poor as this truck is fun to drive loaded and gives me great piece of mind when towing. By far the best Ford I have owned.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have owned Ford F-250's since the 70's, usually buying a new one with every body change. don't use every day, however need a heavy truck to pull equipment weekly and a large boat a few times a year.  This is my first diesel & automatic tranny and other than the fuel usage it is a great extremely quiet engine with exceptional acceleration. My previous was a 99 super duty with a V-10 w/ 5 speed OD tranny and no regrets there either. Best truck I have ever owned. Dodge, GMC & Chevy aren't even in the same leaguewith this beautiful beast.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: The truck has some great features. It drives and handles great. It will pass everything except a station. I have had the truck 7 months and have put over 10k in fuel. When pulling I have a average mpg of 3-5 and empty 9-11. Now it's falling apart new grille, door handle, radiator, trailer wiring shorted out. I have owned Fords all my life. It's all I have ever had. This will be the last.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Nice Truck but don't forget to gas up
Review: I've owned Ford trucks since the 70's and was always a ford person.  MY 2002 powerstroke was the best truck i ever had. The 2008 diesel has a lot of power but terrible fuel econony - and that's and understatement.They moved the engine into the cab resulting in less room in the interior - no back seat room for the third person. There's no side pouches or creature comforts for anyone riding in the back.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I traded up after my 2006 deisel was totaled. If I had only known I would have gotten one sooner! No noticeable turbo lag with new set up. Interior is much nicer although upfitter switches get in the way of cup holders.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I've had my Super Duty for five months and I truly love it. The diesel is so quite. This summer while on vaction we were stopped for road construction and the sign lady came over to talk to us. She commented how quite the diesel was. On that trip we towed our trailer which is 11,200 lbs over two 11,000 ft passes. We had lots of power. The tow/haul feature is really nice. The ride is very comfortable and the truck is a lot of fun to drive. At times parking can be rought.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab XLT 4dr SuperCab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I traded in my 2001 Ford F350 7.3 for this new (2008 Ford F450 6.4 twin turbo 4.88 Rear end) and will never look back. This truck pulls like a dream and I cant even feel my 12,000 lbs trailer full of construction tools behind this beautiful truck. Every time I fill up pepole stop and ask about it although the only complaint is the 10 MPG it is well worth it!! I now have 4800 miles and 225 hours on this great engine and can't complain after only 1 month in service its in for a long haul.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I have now had two full months with my new F250 King Ranch crew cab 6.4L diesel 4x4.A truly great truck. Excellent power and refinement.Having owned over 10 Ford trucks this one is by far the best overall.Diesel has solid power and is very quiet.Fuel economy is currently 17 mpg on highway, 13 city and 12-14 highway towing a 9000 lb. trailer.I expect some improvement with a few more miles.Truck is well made,finish work is the equivalent of an expensive luxury car. No rattles or squeaks.  Stereo, DVD nav are nice options, and the seats! An expensive truck. One can get another brand for less, but this is simply the best heavy duty pickup I have ever driven, and I have used many. Great job Ford!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Traded in my 2004 PSD Crew short bed for this 2008. Amazing truck. Diesel is new model, very powerful and extremely quiet. Great fuel mileage, and tows my Jayco fifth wheel like it's not really there. The cab is so nice! Quiet, comfortable...all the amenities, too!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty SuperCab Lariat 4dr SuperCab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I never thought Ford could turn around the Super Duty and produce the truck they have with this new model.  Unbelievable appearance, ride and muscle.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab FX4 4dr Crew Cab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I now have just under 130,000 miles on this truck and I have hauled tons and tons of rock, 5th wheel, and a car. I have had nothing but great performance, no repairs, and perfect reliability. I have the V8 and it has been able to haul everything including a couple of times overloaded with ease.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab FX4 4dr Crew Cab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: Warning of issue with Ford Diesel Engines
Review: Ford corporate recently told us that we need to test the diesel fuel every time before filling up our 2008 Ford diesel F250.This occurred after contaminants were found in the fuel and we now have up to $12k in damages.The truck has less than 70k miles and this is the second time this has occurred (first at 24k).Truck still under warranty. No abnormal driving, primarily highway and occassional pulling of a 3 horse gooseneck trailer. All scheduled maintenance, including fuel filters, was regularly performed by a Ford Dealer. No warning lights came on before engine shut down.Through postings on diesel forums and leasing associations, we are hearing this is not an uncommon problem.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XL 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I kept reading post after post on the internet about the 6.4 and wondering if my day would come? Well here it is. My $58,000 truck with 126,000 miles on it, with no warning except for the temp. gauge climbing, which I immediately pulled over and stopped trashed the motor. Guess I knew after Ford adandoned the motor after only three years I was in trouble. Shame on you Ford!!Thanks for no help and a $17,000 repair bill..........

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought the truck new for towing our 31 foot camper. The 6.4 with auto trans does a fantastic job. I have had one problem with the backup camera but the dealer fixed that problem. The truck has 26,000 miles on it and has done everything I have wanted it to do. I will buy another Ford when the time comes to replace this one. I just don't see it happening for a long time.I love my truck....

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab XLT 4dr Crew Cab LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Ordered from the factory. I love the truck overall. It does exactly what I wanted it for. Mileage poor but I knew that. 11.99 max. I can haul over a cord of wood out with a cattle rack, pull any tree I can reach out onto the road anywhere anytime. The power train has been awesome. The exterior not so much. Sheet metal and paint very weak. Bed is too easily damaged with under max recommended loads.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab FX4 4dr Crew Cab 4WD LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I bought this truck to replace my last 4wd.  We purchased a 30' travel trailer and the previous truck just couldn't cut the mustard!  This SD justs runs away with it!  This is my first diesel as I never would pay the extra but I always wanted one.  WOW!  I shouldn't have waited so long.  I have always loved my Ford trucks and this one is the best I have ever owned.  For it's size, it gets decent mileage.  I can squeak 17mpg on the highway driving 68-70 mph.  If I drive 80 mph, it get about 15mpg.  Combined city and highway and driving pretty hard, I get 14mpg.  Not bad for a giant, heavy truck.  I had a 76 Chevy 4wd way back when that got 10 mpg and if I were really careful I could get 11mpg!

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Awesome truck!  This is my 7th truck and it is by far the best truck I've ever purchased.  Turned in an 01 Dodge 3500 dually and have not looked back except for fuel economy.  I have 46K on the Ford with 14 months of ownership - trust me the mileage does not get better with time.  Towing is incredible pulled a total load of 23,800 lbs from Lorton, VA to Kansas City, MO - great performance.  Keeping RPM below 2K and mileage was 12 MPG with load.  W/O load get 16.2 MPG if less than 2K RPM and 15.8 MPG over 2K RPM. Interior size is outstanding wife and 2 kids love this vehicle for road trips. Wife likes to drive because visbility is outstanding and pedals can be adjusted to her confort level.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I do a lot of pulling and highway miles. I love the power the 6.4 has, but I am not a fan of the exhaust cleaning. Drags your MPG down. If you regulate your speed by the turbo, (less than 10 psi), you will maximize MPG. At 50,000 miles, average highway is running at 16.2 pulling around 8,000 lbs.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab FX4 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review_Title: I wish I had not gotten rid of my Dodge!
Review: I bought this truck used in 2009, had 20k miles,I have had to take the truck into the dealership 3 times due to the check engine light. The firts time I towed our toyhuler I blew a head gasket, we spent over 6k in repairs within the 1st year of owning this truck. This is the first FORD truck I own and I have a feeling it will be the last! I owned a 02 Dodge Ram 1500 and NEVER had to take in to the dealership for anything but regular maintance. Oh yeah almost forgot the MPG sucks.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: I love my truck.. I moved up for the f150 to the f250 for power and towing. I am very impressed with truck..

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab LB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Have a F-450 with 52k miles.  Spent $1400 dollars yesterday to replace the radiator which was leaking, the 4 o- rings and clips which were leaking, and the line behind one of the EGRs was leaking.  My wife is pissed and ain't talking to me. I also get a whooping 9.7 mpg and when I installed a Superchip programmer the truck locked out.  Had to have it towed and reprogrammed, so be careful with after market programmers. Truck itself is beautiful and the turning radius is awesome, but it does spend a lot of time in the shop.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
Review: Love the 6.4 Diesel.  Best truck i've owned.  So solid and powerful its like cheating the vehicle in tow.  Makes bid loads feel like my sons tonka toys.  Ford has done it again.

Vehicle_Title: 2008 Ford F-250 Super Duty Crew Cab Lariat 4dr Crew Cab 4WD SB (5.4L 8cyl 6M)
